subject: PR creation + Coupa/Ariba supplier ID guidance and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: PR creation + Coupa/Ariba supplier ID guidance and next steps

Hi Sophie —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for walking us through Acme Health's use case. Quick recap and next steps from our side so procurement has what you need to raise the PR: 

1) Commercial path (decision needed)
   - PO (preferred for most customers) — standard monthly invoiced arrangement.
   - Company card — can be used for smaller initial purchases or POCs, but may require a cardholder and limits from your finance team.
   - Marketplace purchase — if you prefer purchasing through a cloud marketplace (Azure/AWS/GCP), we can check availability and provide SKUs/pricing. Let us know if marketplace is preferred.

2) PR creation guidance (Coupa / Ariba)
   - Vendor name to use: "Redwood Inference, Inc."
   - Include Deal ID on the PR/PO: RDW-2026-ACME-0042 (this helps us map invoices and apply credits).
   - If Redwood is NOT already in your supplier list: create a supplier request and attach the vendor onboarding packet (attached: Redwood_Supplier_Info.pdf). Fields typically required: legal name, remit address, tax ID/W-9 (we include a placeholder in the attachment), primary contact, and invoice remit-to email (invoices@redwoodinference.com).
   - For Coupa: when creating a PR, reference the supplier as above and attach the draft SOW or quote. If you need our Redwood supplier ID, we can request provisioning with your Coupa admin once you confirm the supplier request number.
   - For Ariba: similar flow — either search for the vendor or submit a supplier onboarding request.

3) Internal ticketing / supplier ID linkage
   - I’ve opened a Sales Ops request so we can track supplier onboarding and mapping on our end: SO-12847 (Sales Ops). Please include the PR/PO number in your reply and we’ll link it back.

4) Next steps / ask of you
   - Can you confirm whether procurement will proceed via PO or card?
   - If PO: please raise a PR and share the PR/PO number and attach it to this thread.
   - If supplier onboarding is required, please send the supplier request number (Coupa/Ariba). We’ll submit our vendor packet and follow up with your admin.

I’ve attached our Supplier Info packet and a PR template you can use as an example. Happy to hop on a 15-min call with procurement if that speeds things up — propose Wed 3/11 at 3pm PT if that works.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0124

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick questions from procurement: 

- We primarily use Coupa, occasionally Ariba. Can you confirm whether Redwood already has a supplier record in our Coupa instance? If so, can you share the supplier ID?
- For PO vs card: finance prefers PO for any contract over $10k. This engagement looks like it will be PO.
- We need a completed vendor onboarding packet (W-9, remit info, contact etc.) — I downloaded your PDF. Is there a completed W-9 in editable form?
- Can you confirm how invoices should be addressed (billing contact) and the expected billing cadence?

I’m attaching our internal PR form (screenshot) — will proceed to raise a PR once I have the supplier ID or vendor onboarding confirmation.

Thanks,

Hi Sophie —

Thanks — that's helpful. Answers below and a short checklist you can paste into Coupa/Ariba supplier request: 

1) Supplier record / ID
   - Redwood is not automatically present in every customer Coupa instance. If you do not find "Redwood Inference, Inc." when searching, please submit a supplier onboarding request and attach the vendor packet (attached).
   - When you have the supplier request number, send it to me and I’ll escalate with our finance ops to get the supplier added and obtain your Coupa supplier ID. I’ve created Sales Ops ticket SO-12847 to track that handoff internally.

2) Vendor onboarding checklist (paste into your supplier request):
   - Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   - Remit address: 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
   - Primary billing email: invoices@redwoodinference.com
   - Tax docs: W-9 (included in vendor packet) — if you need an editable file, I can send a DOC/PDF.
   - Bank remit / ACH details: provided upon completed supplier onboarding (we can share secure banking details after the vendor is accepted).
   - Primary contact: Marissa Cole, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, +1 (415) 555-0124

3) PR / PO guidance
   - Please include the Deal ID RDW-2026-ACME-0042 on the PO so our billing team can apply it correctly.
   - Invoices are monthly in arrears unless you prefer upfront; we’ll invoice to the billing email above.

4) Marketplace note
   - If you prefer marketplace purchasing, please say so and I’ll confirm SKU availability for your environment — that often shortens procurement loops but depends on marketplace coverage.

5) Next steps (recommended)
   - Sophie: submit supplier onboarding request in Coupa and share the supplier request number (or the PR/PO number if you raise a PR directly).
   - We: once you share the request number/PR, we’ll open the Finance Ops workflow and push for Coupa supplier ID provisioning.

I attached a DOC version of the W-9 in the vendor packet and a PR template. If helpful, Aditya and I can join a short call with your procurement admin to speed this along.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_Supplier_Info.pdf, PR_Template_Acme.xls
